title: British Shepherd's Pie
description: A classic British comfort dish made with ground meat, vegetables, and mashed potatoes. Shepherd's Pie is a hearty, satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works well

instructions: In a large pan over medium-high heat, cook ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add chopped onion, carrot, and mushroom to the pan and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Stir in flour to thicken the gravy, then add beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Add chopped collards to the pan and cook until wilted.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes, spreading them evenly to cover the top.
Dot the top of the potatoes with butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
